name: consentflow
description: Cookie consent management platform: scanner, banner, geo rules, consent logs and dashboard.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @consentflow/banner && npm run build -w @consentflow/api && npm run build -w @consentflow/scanner && npm run build -w @consentflow/dashboard
scripts.test: npm test -w @consentflow/shared && npm test -w @consentflow/banner && npm test -w @consentflow/api
